_doc: Seats per party in each draw of 'Nuestra predicción' (pipeline/modelos/portada.py), the sum of its provincial seats: 20000 draws of K7, 20000 draws of C0, 20000 draws of R0, 20000 draws of M0, 20000 draws of L0, 20000 draws of P0, 20000 draws of E0, in that order; every party with a seat in some draw, so each draw adds up to 350. Subsample of 10,000 of the 140,000 draws (fixed seed 2911) to keep the file small; every summary in the model's JSON uses all 140,000.
